✂️ RawBT Example 07 - Paper Cut

📌 Note: Paper cutting only works on printers with an auto-cutter. Budget thermal printers may not have this feature.

Full Cut:

Full cut - Paper is completely separated
job.cut(); // Default full cut job.cut('full'); // Explicit full cut // Raw command job.raw([0x1D, 0x56, 0x00]); // GS V 0

Partial Cut:

Partial cut - Small uncut portion remains
job.cut('partial'); // Raw command job.raw([0x1D, 0x56, 0x01]); // GS V 1

Feed Then Cut:

// Feed 3 lines then cut job.feed(3); job.cut(); // Or use feed-and-cut command job.raw([0x1D, 0x56, 0x42, 0x03]); // GS V B n
